author: Author
noOptions: This category has no editable settings.

conflict: The menu session or saved queue changed. Reload before saving again.
invalid: Check the highlighted input fields before saving.
actionHint: Runs once at inventory close after Save & Apply.
lastFailed: Previous apply was refused or incomplete. See Information.

queueCleared: All draft and queued changes discarded.
modTexts: Mod names, categories and option descriptions use the text supplied by each mod.
mouse: Mouse controls; native tabs and Back remain with the game.
resetHint: Resets this category's editable values in the draft.
restart: A mod may report that restarting the game is required.
writes: Changes use the mod's registered SDK options and lifecycle functions.
applyDetails: Details are shown in the apply result.
catalogPartial: Some mod data could not be read. See Information.
sessionHint: Settings are captured when the inventory opens. Save & Apply before closing to keep edits.
keyHint: Enter a key name, e.g. F5, NumPadZero or ThumbMouseButton. Empty = unbound. Enter confirms.

captureClickInline: Capture ready for {name}: Click the orange highlighted key field.
captureReleaseInline: Key press received. Release the key to use it in the draft.
captureStartError: Key capture could not start. Please reload this tab.
